# A Markdown document's own HTML takes its pane nowhere nobody clicked: not
# a <meta http-equiv="refresh">, not a form (the page's CSP says
# form-action 'none'); and a link that wants a window of its own to a file
# that might run asks first, as any link of the page does. tests/run.sh
# makes @DIR@ with refresh.md, form.md, elsewhere.html and tool.command.
open:@DIR@/refresh.md
page-wait:go
wait:1.0
expect-page:Refresh document
expect-page-not:Elsewhere
open:@DIR@/form.md
page-wait:go
expect-page:Form document
page-js:document.querySelector('meta[http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy"]').content ==> form-action 'none'
page-click:Send
wait:1.0
expect-page:Form document
expect-page-not:Elsewhere
page-click:css:a[target="_blank"]
wait:0.5
expect-sheet-text:Open “tool.command”?
sheet:Cancel
expect-page:Form document
